title: Headless runtimes without a stdin form take a large prompt from a 0600 file
description: Headless pi, cursor and muse sessions with a prompt over the inline limit receive a short pointer prompt on argv naming a 0600 file holding the full prompt, stdin runtimes and small prompts behave as today, and a review of a very large diff on pi posts a verdict.
